title: A static property read through an instance stops with an internal error.
text: For a class with `public static int $x`, `$p->x` and `$p?->x` on an instance pass `nvs check`, and `nvs run` then stops with `E0901` ("nvs-codegen does not lower the property `P::x`, which this unit declares no slot for yet"). A static method called with `?->` runs. It closes when the checker reports a static property reached through `->` or `?->` where it is written, naming `P::$x`, with a conformance case for each operator.
